Dodge Ram 1500 Truck Decals – Green Escapes Construction LTD

To be able to run a business requires smart and practical thinking. For things like, where and what to invest in, what products to promote, and how and when to promote the products. A successful business owner knows the execution of these actions must be accomplished keeping the target audience in mind. Among other things such as your industry, budget and goal.

One of our returning customers, “Green Escapes Construction LTD” knows how to grab a perfect opportunity to advertise a brand for a long time with just a one-time payment. Green Escapes Construction LTD had recently got commercial decals for their Ford F-250 truck to advertise their business. Since they see the potential in promoting a business using truck decals, they brought in another one of the trucks that they use for their Ice management and removal side of the business.

The reason our clients return to us with more job requests is that we give it our all. We use the best quality material available on the market and install it via the capable hands of our installers. The decals we installed on our client’s Ford F-250 proved to be beneficial and it only makes sense to grab the opportunity for other company vehicles that they have.

The company uses the Dodge Ram 1500 to sprinkle salt on Ice or remove it in the mornings and then the truck just sits there all day till the next morning. The client saw a chance, a chance to use all that extra real estate on the Dodge Ram 1500. What’s better than having a Dodge Ram 1500 with nothing on it? A Dodge Ram 1500 truck with commercial decals on it, promoting your business while it’s out at work or simply parked in front of your shop. In regards to this vehicle, we spotted it at the local hardware store multiple times. Proving that the decals stand out.

The truck decals, like most commercial decals, were simple and to the point. With a logo that pops, services offered and contact information. Having all that on your truck makes it the moving billboard that advertises your business wherever it goes. We used quality material offered by Avery Dennison to print and laminate the decals. We’ve attached pictures of the Dodge Ram 1500 on this page before and after the installation of truck decals and lettering.

Why Truck Decals?

Let’s say you have a marketing budget of $1000. The question is how you use the money. Do you buy online ads, flyers, brochures, update your website or get vinyl decals to promote your business? And if you choose any of these options, how do you spend it on online ads, tv or newspaper ads or do you choose something that lasts a lot longer? Any sane person would want something that lasts a lot longer for the same amount of money that would boost you for just a day or two. Truck Decals unlike other modes of advertisements, give you full control over the design and size and last for years.

You’re the boss and there are no restrictions on the kind of font, logo and amount of information you can include. Those are just a few of the benefits of truck decals and lettering. To learn about all the benefits, check our previous blog post about decals, here.

If you have a truck that you believe could be the moving billboard for your company or business, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts about your requirements and get a quote on truck decals cost.
